# Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings

## ![](nova.png) Amazon — Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings

## Model Details

Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings accepts text, images, audio, and video.
+ **Model lifecycle:** Active

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Text | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Embedding | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) Invoke | ![Yes](icon-yes.png) bedrock-runtime |
